spatialGeneExpressionCells.name: label
spatialGeneExpressionCells.documentation: A human-readable label for this segmentation (e.g. 'SAW cellbin adjusted').

spatialGeneExpressionCells.name: n_cells
spatialGeneExpressionCells.documentation: The number of data rows in cells.tsv.

spatialGeneExpressionCells.name: segmentation_method
spatialGeneExpressionCells.documentation: How cells were segmented (e.g. 'SAW v7.1.2 CellBin', 'Cellpose 2.0'). Stereo-seq CellBin segments nuclei from the stain image and dilates outward, so a 'cell' is a nucleus plus a margin, not a measured cell body.

spatialGeneExpressionCells.name: segmentation_dilation
spatialGeneExpressionCells.documentation: The radial expansion applied to each segmented nucleus, in coordinate_units. 0 if none. SAW's default is about 5 micrometers.

spatialGeneExpressionCells.name: coordinate_units
spatialGeneExpressionCells.documentation: The units of the centroid and contour coordinates. These are the SOURCE coordinate units (DNB chip units for Stereo-seq), the same frame as the pyramid's origin_x and origin_y, NOT micrometers unless stated.

spatialGeneExpressionCells.name: contours_present
spatialGeneExpressionCells.documentation: 1 if contours.bin was written, 0 if only centroids are available.

spatialGeneExpressionCells.name: contour_reference
spatialGeneExpressionCells.documentation: Whether contour vertices are stored relative to their cell centroid ('centroid') or in absolute source coordinates ('absolute'). Storing this removes the need to guess from vertex magnitude, which is what the source h5ad forces.

spatialGeneExpressionCells.name: n_vertices_per_cell
spatialGeneExpressionCells.documentation: 0 means contours are ragged and contours.bin carries an offset array (the normal case; SAW pads a fixed 32-slot array with a sentinel and about two thirds of slots are padding, which is stripped on ingest). A positive value means every cell has exactly that many vertices and no offset array is present.

spatialGeneExpressionCells.name: data_type_vertex
spatialGeneExpressionCells.documentation: Integer type of the contour vertex arrays.

spatialGeneExpressionCells.name: data_type_offset
spatialGeneExpressionCells.documentation: Integer type of the contour offset array.

spatialGeneExpressionCells.name: contour_format_version
spatialGeneExpressionCells.documentation: The version of the contour binary layout. See spatialGeneExpressionCells.md.
